resources.string: Lets you move an on-screen pointer and tap by swiping on the fingerprint sensor, and draws the pointer as a small overlay icon.

Turn on the switch below, then enable "Fingerprint Mouse Control" on the Accessibility Settings screen that opens. Once enabled, swipe up, down, left, or right on your fingerprint sensor to move the pointer. Swipe the same direction twice quickly to click.
Find \"Fingerprint Mouse Control\" in the list and turn it on
